full_name: Lauren K. Williams | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2020–2021 Mathematics Sally Starling Seaver Professor Harvard University
bio: During her fellowship year at Radcliffe, Lauren K. Williams is working with Sergey Fomin and Andrei Zelevinsky on the book “Introduction to Cluster Algebras.” She is also continuing her research on interacting particle systems, the positive Grassmannian, and the amplituhedron.
